last_summary: v1 begins with alien presence, shocked humans, a human-only lab-console struggle, and blue-skinned aliens moving through a jungle-like environment. v2 ends with vehicle combat, cargo loading in a glowing swamp, an aircraft flight, and a sick person on a monitor. The strongest before/after pattern is humans and aliens becoming separated or transported amid conflict, which best supports a sympathetic-human escape/aid plan, though cargo contents and the exact cause of the combat remain uncertain.
